events.title: Update 2.4 — Two New Languages, New Music, and a CHF Lesson
events.summary: A small but noticeable demo update.Six languages. Traditional Chinese (繁體中文) and Spanish (Español) join Russian, English, Simplified Chinese and Japanese. events.title: Demo 2.1 is out!
events.summary: Hi!The demo has been updated and is available on Windows and Mac. Not a huge list of changes, but the ones that are there matter.New: limit ordersA regular exchange works the simple way: you buy at the price currently on the board. A limit order means something else, namely "buy when the price gets down to here".
